applies_to: all preflight-smoke and full-sweep raw TCP/MQTT sender rows in this run
declared_timing_boundary: immediately before first framed TCP or MQTT byte is sent through complete correlated application-acknowledgment validation
implemented_timing_start: time.monotonic_ns immediately before the first framed TCP length prefix or complete MQTT PUBLISH packet is passed to sendall
implemented_timing_end: time.monotonic_ns immediately after the complete application acknowledgment has been received and parsed for exact frame length, magic, and protocol version
accepted_row_rule: A sender row is accepted only after every outside-timed comparison passes; the edge already validated the complete request payload length and CRC32 before emitting the acknowledgment.
result_interpretation: Use rtt_ms as monotonic complete-application-acknowledgment receipt-and-parse RTT. Do not claim that the subsequent local correlation comparisons are included in rtt_ms.
